lines.text: Your record carries an interruption. Keep the actual interval with the manifest. An apology is not an explanation.
Nine years of headers on your copy. Log says Ferrymen recipients. Someone still has to answer for the older addresses.
Your records carry the matching consignment IDs. Compare the allocation with the delivery. Keep both copies.
Your convoy arrives without a recorded loss. Dispatch rates it amber. A safe arrival does not tell you what sets that rating.
Stay with the convoy on your work card. Dispatch writes the rating; you bring the people back.
Dispatch posts the escort work. Read the route and the rate. I say bring a spare magazine.
Gate opens on Dispatch's clock, not mine. Not yours either.
